findings.evidence: ColorDecomposition.lean:88-89 `def colorSingletProj (N : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) := ((N : ℂ)⁻¹ • traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℂ ℂ).smulRight 1`; :121-123 `colorOctetProj_apply : colorOctetProj N ψ = ψ - ((N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ψ.trace) • 1`. With `(1 : Matrix _ _ ℂ)⁻¹ = 1` these are exactly `tracePart 1`/`tracelessPart 1` of MetricTrace.lean:73, 85.

findings.issue: `Matrix.tracePart`/`tracelessPart` at `g = 1` reproduce the existing in-repo pair `colorSingletProj`/`colorOctetProj` (EpsilonEridani/QFT/Quarkonium/NRQCD/ColorDecomposition.lean:88, 99) together with a parallel lemma set: `colorSingletProj_apply` (:92) = `tracePart_apply`; `colorOctetProj_eq` (:112) = `tracelessPart_eq_one_sub`; `colorSingletProj_add_colorOctetProj` (:127) = `tracePart_add_tracelessPart`; `isIdempotentElem_colorSingletProj`/`isIdempotentElem_colorOctetProj` (:136, :145, also via `.one_sub`) = `isIdempotentElem_tracePart`/`isIdempotentElem_tracelessPart`; `colorSingletProj_mul_colorOctetProj`/`colorOctetProj_mul_colorSingletProj` (:163, :168) = `tracePart_tracelessPart`/`tracelessPart_tracePart`; `colorSingletProj_apply_eq_self_iff` (:179, multiples of 1) = `tracelessPart_eq_zero_iff`; `colorOctetProj_apply_eq_self_iff` (:190, traceless) = `tracePart_eq_zero_iff`/`tracelessPart_eq_self_iff`. findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Trace.lean:89 `def traceLinearMap [Semiring α] [Module α R] : Matrix n n R →ₗ[α] R`; Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Bilinear.lean:33 `def mulLeftLinearMap (X : Matrix l m A) : Matrix m n A →ₗ[R] Matrix l n A` (`@[simps]`); `LinearMap.smulRight` as used in ColorDecomposition.lean:89.
findings.fix: Define `tracePart g := ((Fintype.card n : K)⁻¹ • (Matrix.traceLinearMap n K K ∘ₗ Matrix.mulLeftLinearMap n K g⁻¹)).smulRight g` and keep `tracePart_apply` as the (now one-line `simp`) interface lemma; this is the same assembly already used for `colorSingletProj`.
findings.issue: `tracePart` is built as a raw `Module.End` with hand-written `map_add'`/`map_smul'` proofs, re-deriving linearity that Mathlib combinators already supply for exactly this shape (trace ∘ left-multiplication, then scaled and sent to a fixed matrix).

summary: The general metric trace/traceless projection is genuinely new upstream, but at g = 1 it is a near-clone of the existing in-repo projector pair colorSingletProj/colorOctetProj and its whole lemma set, which should be re-based on it; the Module.End is also hand-assembled where Mathlib combinators (traceLinearMap, mulLeftLinearMap, smulRight) do the job — the very combinators the colour file already uses.
